remarks: Great opportunity to own this wonderful contemporary-style condo offering 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and approximately 1,300 square feet of living space with tremendous potential to customize and make it your own. Ideal for first-time homebuyers or buyers looking to invest and revamp, this unit provides a solid layout and the perfect canvas for personal touches and upgrades. The main level features a bright, open layout with a spacious living room, gas fireplace, and seamless flow into the kitchen, making it ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A convenient half bath on the main level is perfect for guests. The upper level offers two generously sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with a full en-suite bathroom, along with an additional full bathroom. The washer and dryer are conveniently located on the bedroom level, adding ease and functionality to daily living. This sun-filled unit enjoys abundant natural light throughout and is located in a secure, well-maintained building. Additional features include two assigned parking spaces, one in the secure garage and one exterior space, both numbered, as well as a private storage unit located in the garage. Perfectly situated in a central Stamford location close to shopping, dining, the train station, I-95, and more. All it needs is some personal touches and an excellent opportunity for updates. Being sold as-is. A fantastic value and opportunity in a prime location.
